0022600146.text: The Portland Trail Blazers, 2-0 and on a two-game win streak, host the Memphis Grizzlies, who are 4-0 with a four-game win streak, sitting 2nd in the Southwest and 5th in the West while Portland is 2nd in the Northwest, one game back, and 4th in the West. The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, and the Trail Blazers won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 122-114 win in Memphis on March 4, 2026. Portland will be without Chris Youngblood (out, ankle soreness) and Shaedon Sharpe (out, knee surgery).
